γείτων: one of the same land, a neighbour
γνώμων: one that knows; carpenter’s square, pointer on sundial
δαιτυμών: one that is entertained, an invited guest
μάρων: son of Euanthes, priest of Apollo in Ismarus
μυρμιδών: Myrmidon, son of Zeus and Eurymedusa
παιάν: paean, choral song addressed to Apollo
παλαίχθων: that has been long in a country, an ancient inhabitant, indigenous
συμφράδμων: one who joins in considering, a counsellor
τηκεδών: a melting away: a wasting away, consumption, decline
φείδων: an oil-can with a narrow neck, that lets only a little run out
φιλοκτήμων: loving possessions, greedy of gain, covetous
ἀλγηδών: a sense of pain, pain, suffering
ἀμφικτίονες: they that dwell round, next neighbours
ἀνδραίμων: Andraemon, king of the Aetolians in Calydon
ἀνθηδών: Anthedon (f for city and founding nymph; m for founding hero)
ἀρίων: Arion: name of a horse; of famous cithara player
ἀρείων: better, stouter, stronger, braver, more excellent
ἀρχιτέκτων: a chief-artificer, master-builder, director of works, architect, engineer
ἄξων: an axle, axis; wooden tablet of laws in Athens
ἠιών: Eïon, town in Thrace, at the mouth of the Strymon
ὁμαίμων: (of the same blood) near akin; (subst.) brother, sister
